seen_definition: Union of the last seven history rows and GT in training records only
cold_definition: Fixed asset universe minus seen; not temporal new-item status

inference.candidate_set: valid natural beam20 union every cold asset row
inference.invalid_sid: missing row -1, never map to row0 or backfill
inference.ranking: FP32 normalized dot product divided by 0.07
inference.cache: full cold FP32 projections, eval only, rebuild after weight changes

training_budget.scheduler: cosine over the original three-epoch budget, unchanged on resume
